questions.question: 为什么仅靠 prompt 要求 'return JSON' 不足以满足生产环境需求？
options: JSON is too verbose (JSON 太冗长)
Prompts are too long (提示太长)
Frontier models comply most of the time but not always; the small fraction of malformed outputs breaks downstream parsers (前沿模型大多数时候会遵守但并不总是；少量格式错误的输出会破坏下游解析器)
Prompting cannot describe schemas (提示无法描述 schema)
questions.explanation: Prompt-only structure works ~80% of the time on frontier models; production needs harder guarantees.

questions.question: Constrained decoding (约束解码) 在每一步生成中修改什么？
options: The KV cache (KV 缓存)
The tokenizer (分词器)
The training loss (训练损失)
The logit vector, masking tokens that would invalidate the target grammar so only valid continuations can be sampled (logit 向量，屏蔽会使目标语法无效的 token，从而只能采样有效的后续内容)
questions.explanation: A logit processor sets invalid tokens to -inf so the softmax cannot sample them.

questions.question: 为什么 constrained decoding 可能比自由生成更快？
options: The model is smaller (模型更小)
Forced scaffold tokens (e.g. '{"name": "') can be emitted directly without sampling, and the valid-token search space shrinks (强制脚手架 token 可直接发出无需采样，且有效 token 搜索空间缩小)
It avoids softmax entirely (完全避免 softmax)
It skips backprop (跳过反向传播)
questions.explanation: Determined tokens skip sampling and reduced valid-token sets shrink the decode cost.

questions.question: 哪种 schema 设计选择可以防止模型过早承诺 (premature commitment)？
options: Put 'answer' first (把 'answer' 放前面)
Use shorter keys (使用更短的键)
Place reasoning fields before the answer/decision field so the model thinks before committing (将 reasoning 字段放在 answer/decision 字段之前，让模型先思考再做出决定)
Use snake_case (使用 snake_case)
questions.explanation: Field order is logic: putting reasoning first lets the model think before locking in an answer.

questions.question: 像 Outlines 这样的基于 FSM 的 constrained decoding 工具有什么限制？
options: They are not deterministic (它们不是确定性的)
They lock you to OpenAI (它们将你锁定到 OpenAI)
Recursive schemas have to be flattened; truly recursive structures need CFG-based engines such as XGrammar (递归 schema 必须被展平；真正的递归结构需要基于 CFG 的引擎如 XGrammar)
They only support enums (它们只支持枚举)
questions.explanation: FSMs cannot represent unbounded recursion; CFG engines handle it.

questions.question: 为什么说 Instructor 不修改 logits？
options: Instructor formats the schema into the prompt and parses/retries the output; logit masking happens server-side or not at all (Instructor 将 schema 格式化进 prompt 并解析/重试输出；logit masking 发生在服务端或根本不发生)
It uses gradient updates (它使用梯度更新)
Required by Anthropic (Anthropic 要求的)
It edits the prompt (它编辑提示)
questions.explanation: Instructor uses provider-side structured output plus client-side validation and retries, not logit masking.

questions.question: 像 date='YYYY-MM-DD' 这样严格的正则可能引入什么问题？
options: It requires CFG support (需要 CFG 支持)
It removes any escape hatch for unknown values, so the model fabricates a date instead of returning null/sentinel (它移除了对未知值的任何逃生通道，导致模型编造日期而不是返回 null/哨兵值)
It breaks JSON parsing (破坏 JSON 解析)
Regex is slow (正则很慢)
questions.explanation: Over-strict grammars force the model to invent values; always allow null/sentinel for unknowns.

questions.question: 何时应该选择 vLLM guided decoding 而非供应商 structured-output API？
options: Always vendor (总是选供应商)
Only for tiny schemas (仅用于微小 schema)
Only with byte-level BPE (仅与字节级 BPE 一起使用)
Self-hosted inference where you control the model and want logit-level guarantees without retries (自托管推理，你控制模型并希望无需重试的 logit 级别保证)
questions.explanation: vLLM guided decoding fits self-hosted serving with logit-level constraints; vendor APIs lock you to their stack.
